author: GameSpot
description:
Graveyard Keeper 2 is a narrative-driven crafting RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. This sequel builds on the cult-favorite formula, expanding it into a zombie-infested Town. 

Craft, trade, optimize supply chains, manage your graveyard, and send undead expeditions to reclaim and revive the city. More graves, a bigger Town, and even more questionable morals. 

Graveyard Keeper 2 will be available on PC, Xbox Series, PS5, Switch 1 and Switch 2. To celebrate the announcement at the Triple-i Initiative, Graveyard Keeper 1 will be available for free on Steam, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S but only for a limited time.

description:
Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Play as Charlie Disco, a fallen icon with one chance to reclaim the spotlight from the Idols – Charlie’s ex-bandmates and musical legends. 

Confront the Idols in stylish combat that syncs to every song, and survive a world torn apart by music, fame, and betrayal. Dead as Disco's music transcends boundaries! Rock out to our streamer safe original soundtrack or beat down to licensed bangers past and present. 

Not enough? Then bring your own killer tracks to the party with My Music! Convert any song in your music library into new game content quickly and easily. 

Coming to Early Access on May 5th 2026!

author: GameSpot
description:
In the first gameplay reveal of Alkahest, the player ventures into dark caves and abandoned ruins now claimed by goblins. Exploration flows into tense encounters, where combat feels physical and grounded - kicks, finishers, and reactive environments turn every fight into controlled chaos. Destructible spaces and systemic physics blur the line between weapon and world, while alchemy adds a layer of creativity, enabling clever interactions both in battle and in traversal.
